items.markdown:
![Best Family Resorts In Phuket: 22 Hotels With Kids Clubs & Beach](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07281446-1672-0139-0000-0cb1335f2a1d:4)
The best family hotels in Phuket include [Katathani Phuket Beach Resort](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Hotels-g293920-zff4-Phuket-Hotels.html), [Sunwing Kamala Beach](https://www.wheressharon.com/best-family-accommodation/where-to-stay-in-phuket-thailand/) , and [JW Marriott Phuket Resort & Spa](https://www.phuket101.net/best-family-hotels-phuket/) . These properties offer tailored kids' clubs, spacious family rooms, and direct access to child-friendly beaches.[](https://www.phuket101.net/best-family-hotels-phuket/) [[1]](https://www.phuket101.net/best-family-hotels-phuket/)[[2]](https://littlepassportcrew.com/family-hotels-phuket-with-kids/)

Top-Rated Family Resorts

- **Katathani Phuket Beach Resort** (Kata Noi Beach): Features 6 pools, direct beachfront access, a mini water slide area, and daily supervised kids' club activities.[](https://www.phuket101.net/best-family-hotels-phuket/) 
- **Sunwing Kamala Beach** (Kamala Beach): Tailored heavily for families and toddlers with 7 pools, themed "Happy Baby Studios," playground facilities, and kid-friendly dining.[[1]](https://www.wheressharon.com/best-family-accommodation/where-to-stay-in-phuket-thailand/)
- **JW Marriott Phuket Resort & Spa** (Mai Khao Beach): A luxury option featuring an award-winning kids' club, turtle shelter visits, batik painting, and shallow shaded pools.[](https://www.phuket101.net/best-family-hotels-phuket/) 
- **Centara Grand Beach Resort Phuket** (Karon Beach): Acts like a mini water park with a lazy river, waterslides, and cliff-jumping zones right by the sea.[](https://www.phuket101.net/best-family-hotels-phuket/) 
- **Holiday Inn Resort Phuket** (Patong Beach): A vibrant mid-range choice centrally located in Patong, offering themed kid suites and dedicated pool zones.[](https://www.phuket101.net/best-family-hotels-phuket/) 

If you share your **children's ages** and your **budget range** , I can recommend the exact hotel area and resort that fits your family best.
